title: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Arbitrary file write leading to remote code execution in CSS editor in Visforms…
description: A critical vulnerability exists in the Joomla vi-solutions Visforms extension versions 1.0.0 through 5.6.3 and 6.0.0 through 6.2.0. The CSS editor component does not restrict file names, extensions, or paths when creating and saving files, allowing privileged backend users to write arbitrary PHP files. This flaw can lead to remote code execution.
